child.text:
[{"insert":"Close Grip Bench Press
 
The close grip bench press is the main pressing lift this cycle. Bringing the hands inside shoulder width shifts work off the chest and onto the triceps, and it keeps the elbows tucked, which is easier on the shoulders. The 20X1 tempo means two seconds down, no pause on the chest, then drive and hold one second at the top. The last set is max unbroken reps at your Set 1 weight, so leave something in the tank for it.
"}]
